body:
I think this could be dropped, AFAIK this was only used for mntent. This wasn't intended to be a general purpose facility for thirdparty modules/platforms to check for headers.

So I'd say we can remove it, and if someone relied on it, they'll hopefully complain and we can re-assess before publishing 4.5.
